outcome: low Apgar score (<7) at fifth minute
cohort: 37,799 singleton births delivered from 2000 to 2013 at Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre (KCMC), excluding multiple births, stillbirths, and infants with birth defects.
finding: Low birth weight was associated with several maternal factors (pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, chronic hypertension, anemia, HIV, smoking, underweight, obesity), obstetric complications (C-section, placental abruption, placenta previa, PROM), and female fetal sex.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a 1.4-fold increased risk of low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight infants were the primary focus of the study.
